features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F91 Main Unit (F9111, F9104-B, F9114, F9114-B); power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Fisheye lens with 185 field of view
Up to 1080p at 60 fps or 720p at 180 fps with AXIS F9111
Rugged sensor (IP6K9K, NEMA 4X, IEC 61373, NEMA TS 2) with SMA connector
M12 lens mount, fixed IR-cut filter
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f2135-re-fisheye-sensor-en-US-382553.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded. consumption_w is the sensor unit's own max draw per datasheet.
